## Athlete intake — Google Form to Postgres

Google Form -> Apps Script `onFormSubmit` -> Caddy `/api/athlete-intake` -> this webhook.
Script source of truth: `automation/athlete-intake/onFormSubmit.gs`.

**Set the shared secret** in `Check Intake Secret` to the same value as the script's `INTAKE_SECRET` property. The endpoint is public; without this anyone can POST fake intakes.

This chunk only receives and stores. The Gemini briefing is the next step and reads from `athlete_intake`.

Home doc: `athlete-onboarding-flow.md` section 3.6
